## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it belongs in the reusable library.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the change.
- [ ] Fixtures, examples, comments, and documentation use neutral workflow data
      and public references.
- [ ] `npm run prepublishOnly` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` passes for browser-visible changes.
- [ ] Public API, contract, migration, and changelog docs are updated where needed.
- [ ] New production dependencies are recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] No secrets, prompts, model inputs, or confidential workflow data are included.

## Compatibility

Call out changes to the DAG contract, ESM/CommonJS exports, TypeScript types,
browser support, Vue/React wrappers, or package adoption guidance.
